name: wumpus-world
description: Mundo de Wumpus com agente lógico e base de conhecimento visível (React + FastAPI).
author: Guilherme Rosário Alves

scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.format: pnpm run format:backend && pnpm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:backend && pnpm run format:check:frontend
scripts.gen:api: uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_openapi.py ../frontend/openapi.json && pnpm --filter frontend gen:api
